mu_S.definition: real root of x^3 - x - 1 (plastic number)
mu_S.role: non-reciprocal Mahler floor; right end of the Salem band (1, mu_S)

log_mu_S.definition: log of the plastic number, in nats
log_mu_S.role: cost floor lambda*log M >= log mu_S

phi.definition: golden ratio (1+sqrt5)/2, root of x^2 - x - 1

log_phi.definition: log of the golden ratio, in nats
log_phi.role: realised cost floor (entropy end of the gap)

phi_squared.role: reciprocal quadratic Mahler jump / squaring image

phi_fourth.definition: phi^4 = (7+3 sqrt5)/2, the 'gap' seed x^2-7x+1 measure
phi_fourth.role: Mahler measure of the gap seed

lehmer_number.definition: largest root and Mahler measure of the Lehmer polynomial x^10+x^9-x^7-x^6-x^5-x^4-x^3+x+1
lehmer_number.role: smallest known Salem number; sits below mu_S inside the Salem band

beta_4.definition: real root of x^4 - x^3 - x^2 - x + 1 (minimal degree-4 Salem number)
beta_4.role: floor for any Salem number housed in K; exceeds phi

sqrt5.role: channel-gap endpoint (distinct from phi and log phi)
